title: Simple Reporting
learning_objectives: Learn to create basic reports and dashboards

introduction.title: Reporting in PEGA
introduction.text: Reporting provides visibility into your business processes and case data. PEGA offers powerful reporting tools that allow you to create dashboards, track performance metrics, and generate insights from your application data. This tutorial covers the fundamentals of creating and configuring reports.

sections.title: Types of Reports
sections.content: PEGA provides several types of reports to meet different business needs.

report_types.description: Display data in tabular format with rows and columns
Aggregate data and show totals, counts, and averages
Visual representation of data using graphs and charts

sections.title: Creating Basic Reports
sections.content: Learn the step-by-step process for creating reports in PEGA.

creation_steps.title: Define Report Purpose
creation_steps.description: Clearly identify what information the report should provide
considerations: How often will it be accessed?
What level of detail is needed?

creation_steps.title: Select Data Source
creation_steps.description: Choose the appropriate data source for your report
options: Case data from specific case types

creation_steps.title: Configure Columns and Filters
creation_steps.description: Select the data fields and filtering criteria

creation_steps.title: Format and Style
creation_steps.description: Apply formatting to make the report readable and professional

sections.title: Dashboard Creation
sections.content: Dashboards combine multiple reports and visualizations for comprehensive views.

dashboard_components.description: High-level metrics that show business performance
Visual representations of trends and patterns

sections.title: Report Best Practices
sections.content: Follow these practices to create effective and useful reports.

practices: Keep reports focused on specific business needs
Use clear, descriptive titles and labels
Limit data ranges for better performance
Use appropriate indexing on data sources
Consider caching for frequently accessed reports
Schedule resource-intensive reports for off-peak hours
Make reports easy to navigate and understand

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Different report types serve different business purposes
Report creation follows a structured process from purpose to formatting
Dashboards provide comprehensive views by combining multiple visualizations
Best practices ensure reports are useful, performant, and user-friendly
Regular review and optimization keep reports relevant and efficient
